summary: Auto Totem & Cursor Simulation, Trigger Bot, Discord Changelog Routing

changes.title: Auto Totem & Cursor Simulation
changes.detail: Fixed Cursor Simulation freezing on InventoryScreen (especially with StreamProof active) by running cursor movement on RenderTickEvent with a tick-completion failsafe, unlocking the cursor before sampling start coordinates, and reading the real screen origin so slots line up even with the Recipe Book open.

changes.title: Trigger Bot
changes.detail: Fixed Targets.shieldBreakActive getting permanently stuck after Auto Mace Swap / Mace Swap when Shield Breaker was disabled, prioritized crosshairTarget across custom Attack Distance settings, removed false fire/poison hurt-time stalls, and prevented block-break state from blocking attacks after moving onto a target.

changes.title: Discord Changelog Routing
changes.detail: Updated CI workflow to route commit changelogs to channel 1537760129427185704 (DISCORDCOMMITWEBHOOKURL / DISCORDBOTTOKEN).
